subject: Todd Blanche Refuses to Pledge DOJ Independence From Trump
posts:
Attorney General declines standard DOJ independence pledge from White House.

Todd Blanche DOJ Independence
Evidence: act with integrity, surrender independence, impartial justice
#Aletheia #USPol

Attorney General Todd Blanche claims the Justice Department will act with integrity while following presidential priorities.
Stated Judgement: (+1.00, +1.00) — Good Preference

Refusing to pledge independence surrenders prosecutorial neutrality to executive political direction.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.59, -0.62) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — Revelation into Destruction. Pre-emptively asserting executive benevolence removes institutional checks.
Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 8.20, Uncertainty z: 2)

- Todd Blanche AG Position: FAIL (-0.88, -0.82) — Subordinates DOJ to White House.
- DOJ Anti-Weaponization Stance: COND (-0.45, -0.30) — Fund killed but tort payouts open.
Newly confirmed Attorney General Todd Blanche stated he will not pledge DOJ independence from the White House, insisting the President would never make unethical demands.

The Bright Side:
Blanche reaffirmed that the controversial $1.776B anti-weaponization fund remains dead.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The position claims adherence to ethics (WHAT), but surrenders structural checks against executive influence over prosecutors (WHO).

Social Physics Analysis:
Assuming the executive will never request unethical actions creates a post-hoc pretext for obedience. Power is concentrated by removing transparent boundaries between personal defense and public prosecution.

The Trajectory: The Path of Revelation into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated ethical guarantees and explicit refusal of institutional independence, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil.

The Unavoidable Truth: Independent prosecution requires dynamic structural separation, not personal trust.

The Unavoidable Lie: Refusing independence merely helps fight crime.

Alethekanon:
Pre-clearing executive directives as inherently ethical invalidates institutional oversight.

Awwthekanon:
Trusting power without boundaries leaves vulnerable people unprotected when rules are bent.

Brothekanon:
Saying 'he'll never ask me to cheat' is usually the first sign that someone is about to cheat.
